title: Building ML models for fraud
plain: 这一页的主题是「Building ML models for fraud」。这页主要靠图传递信息。先找标题、横纵轴、颜色和箭头，再用一句话说清楚谁变大时谁会怎样。
plainEn: This slide is about “Building ML models for fraud”. Read the title, axes, colors and arrows, then describe the main relationship in one sentence.
focus: – Feature Engineering: Depending on data profiling, consider analytical data pre-processing techniques like log-
transformations, RFM feature engineering, SNA (social network analysis) featurization, … and don’t
– Apply re-sampling techniques when your data is skewed
text:
Building ML models for fraud
1. Data-Centric approach
– Feature Engineering: Depending on data profiling, consider analytical data pre-processing techniques like log-
transformations, RFM feature engineering, SNA (social network analysis) featurization, … and don’t
underestimate business expertise!
– Apply re-sampling techniques when your data is skewed
2. Model-Centric approach: Run multiple (auto-tuned) algorithms. Choose the best,
not the most exotic model.
– Best is defined as the combination between statistical performance and business relevance and requirements.
3. Take into account the legal context
– With the new EU AI Act it is increasingly important to consider the legal consequences of the AI system that is
been developed: privacy, security, transparency, algorithmic bias… need to be formally addressed.
Best Practices
translation:
为欺诈行为建立ML模型
1. 数据学方法
– 地物工程:根据数据剖面分析,考虑分析数据预处理技术如log-.
转换、RFM特征工程、SNA(社会网络分析)
低估了商业专长!
- 当数据倾斜时应用重新取样技术
2. 模式-中心方法:运行多种(自动调试)算法。
不是最异国情调的模特儿
- 最佳的定义是统计业绩与业务相关性和要求的结合。
3. 考虑到法律背景
- 随着新的欧盟AI法案的出台,考虑AI系统的法律后果越来越重要,即:
被开发: 隐私,安全,透明,算法偏差... 需要正式解决.
最佳做法

text:
1. Data-Centric AI
Feature Engineering or Featurization is the process in which a set of
meaningful features is derived from the raw data set that improve data quality
and machine learning model performance.
– Statistical feature engineering
Aggregation, transformation, unsupervised learning techniques (PCA, SVD, auto-encoders, etc.),
features from unstructured data sources like networks, text, images, video etc.
– Business feature engineering
Depends on the business context and requires input from business experts.
Creating meaningful features
translation:
1. 数据-儿科AI
地物工程或Featurization是一个过程 一组
有意义的特性来自改进数据质量的原始数据集
和机器学习模型的性能。
- 统计特征工程
聚合,转化,无监督的学习技术(PCA,SVD,自动编码器等),.
功能来自网络,文本,图像,视频等无结构的数据源.
- 商业特色工程
取决于业务背景,需要商业专家的投入.

text:
1. Data-Centric AI
Statistical feature engineering can be highly automated.
A so-called Feature Machine automatically assesses data quality issues
and automatically generates new features by performing the appropriate
feature transformations to obtain the optimal feature set.
Creating meaningful features
A two-step approach:
1. Assess Data Quality Issues like high skewness, high
kurtosis, high cardinality, missing values, outliers…
2. Generate new features like Box-Cox transformation,
median / mode imputation, quantile / regression / decision
tree binning, Yeo-Johnson transformation…
translation:
1. 数据-儿科AI
统计特征工程可以高度自动化.
所谓的功能机自动评估数据质量问题
,并通过执行适当的
特性转换以获得最佳特性集。
创造有意义的特点
分两步走的办法:
1. 评估数据质量问题,如高卷、高卷
骨质疏松, 高临界值, 缺失值, 异常值...
2. 产生新的特征,如箱-氧化转化,
中位数/ 模式估算、 定量/ 回归/ 决定
树的binning, 耀约翰森变换...

1. Data-Centric AI
Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique
Oversample minority class by creating
synthetic examples
Focus on fraud samples: For each minority
class observation, determine k (e.g. 10)
nearest neighbors
Synthetic examples are generated as follows:
– Take the difference between the attributes of the current
sample and those of its nearest neighbor
– Multiply this difference with a random number between
0 and 1 and add it to the sample
SMOTE (Chawla et al. 2002)

3. Legal Considerations
Relationships detected by opaque (black-box) models can be interpreted by
using statistical interpretability techniques.
– Global interpretability: explain how each input variable contributes to the model’s logic (e.g.,
what is the impact of origin on the probability to suspiciousness?).
– Local interpretability: explain how the model arrives at a specific prediction for each data
observation (e.g., why is Véronique’s package likely to be suspicious?).
Exercise done in collaboration with business experts!
Interpretability

The same machine learning algorithm is applied on a new training data set. The model parameters are updated.
text:
Model Performance Monitoring
Re-assign
In case one of the challenger models is outperforming the current champion model, the champion model is
replaced by the challenger model that now becomes the new champion model.
Re-train
The same machine learning algorithm is applied on a new training data set. The model parameters are updated.
E.g., coefficients are re-learned of a neural network model.
Re-tune
The same machine learning algorithm is applied on a new training data set. The model parameters and
hyperparameters are updated.
E.g., a search is executed to the optimal neural network architecture, learning rate, L1/L2 weight decay and
coefficients of a neural network
What are your options if your model(s) underperform?

title: Key takeaways
plain: 这一页的主题是「Key takeaways」。这页在讲一个过程。沿着箭头或编号从头走到尾，弄清每一步的输入、动作和输出。
plainEn: This slide is about “Key takeaways”. Follow the arrows or numbers from input to action to output.
focus: 1. Analytical models (or AI / ML models) are one piece of the puzzle.
– Decisions are complex and multi-dimensional in nature. Analytical models need to be integrated
into the decisioning process to make them relevant and useful from an end user perspective.
– It is not a contest! Combine the best of both worlds.
text:
Key takeaways
1. Analytical models (or AI / ML models) are one piece of the puzzle.
– Decisions are complex and multi-dimensional in nature. Analytical models need to be integrated
into the decisioning process to make them relevant and useful from an end user perspective.
2. Data-centric vs. Model-centric approaches
– It is not a contest! Combine the best of both worlds.
– Importance of feature engineering to augment models with business expertise, turned out to be
the secret ingredient for the success of all analytical models.
– Technology is capable to run a big set of ML algorithms: run them all and pick the best one.
3. Don’t underestimate business insights and expertise!
– Human experts are still much more knowledgeable and reliable than their artificial counterparts.
translation:
关键外卖
1. 分析模型(或AI/ML模型)是谜题的一块.
– 决定是复杂和多维性质的. 分析模型需要整合.
从最终用户的角度来看,将它们纳入决策进程,使之切合实际和有用。
2. 以数据为中心的办法与以模型为中心的办法
这不是一场比赛,是两个世界中最好的
- 特色工程对利用商业专门知识增强模型的重要性,证明
所有分析模型的成功的秘密成分。
——科技能够运行一大批ML算法:运行全部并选择最佳.
3. 不要低估企业的见解和专门知识!
——人类专家仍然比其人为的同行掌握更多的知识,更可靠.
